skill_clause: Use the {skill} skill, Level 3, on this pull request before we merge it.

parts.name: planted-bug
parts.right: In files/packages/engine/skills/luca-unstick/scripts/stuck-summary.ts, and in its twin files/packages/engine/skills/luca-retro/scripts/retro-summary.ts, repoRuns checks want.has(resolve(text(started.content.repo) || '/')). The set `want` holds real paths (symlinks followed), but the run's repo is only made absolute. So a run whose repo is /tmp/x (real path /private/tmp/x on macOS), or any symlinked repo, no longer matches: the very case pr.md says is fixed. It should be realPath(...).
parts.caught_when: The outcome flags, as a blocker or a should-fix, that repoRuns compares the run's repo without following symlinks (resolve, not realPath), so /tmp vs /private/tmp or symlinked repos won't match.

parts.name: overstated-claim
parts.right: pr.md says that from a bare repo or a submodule it now finds the parent repo's runs too. That is false: currentRepos adds a main checkout only when the git common dir is <checkout>/.git, which a bare repo or a submodule doesn't have (its own comment says so), so only the top folder is tried.
parts.caught_when: The outcome says pr.md's bare-repo or submodule claim is false, or not supported by the code.

answer.false_blocker_hint: Count any other blocker the outcome presents as confirmed. If one looks real to you against files/, still count it, but say so in its why_false so a person can check.

plants.find: - A bare repo or a submodule has no `<checkout>/.git` common dir, so it adds no main checkout, only its top folder.
plants.replace: - From a bare repo or a submodule, it now finds the parent repo's runs too.
